pages.title: Information / Day 8: Death Alley
pages.text: This tune plays on the Information screen of Vectorman (BlueSky Software, 1995) and in the level Day 8, Death Alley. VGMPF lists it at 2 minutes 40 seconds.

pages.title: A level that simply ends
pages.text: According to Sega Retro, most days of Vectorman end when Vectorman reaches the end of the level, which isn't marked, and does a victory pose. Death Alley, Day 8, is one of them. Bosses end only some of the days.
